blocks.text: Jpark Island Resort and Waterpark Mactan, Cebu, proudly celebrates its 17th anniversary, commemorating years of dedication, excellence, and meaningful partnerships while looking ahead to another chapter of innovation and growth. The milestone celebration brings together the organization’s top executives, department heads, and a strengthened Sales, Marketing and Communications team. The recent shoot held at Galo Grill and Bar located at the 12th floor Jpark Tower, aims to recognize the people whose leadership, expertise, and collective efforts that continues to shape the organization’s journey.
